description: Begin a chunked upload for an image YOU generated in this conversation whose base64 is too large to send inline (a chart, quote card, or edited image). Returns an uploadId; then stream the base64 in small chunks via append_generated_media_chunk and finish with finish_generated_media_upload. Images only, 3MB decoded max. ONLY for files YOU generated in this conversation (charts, cards, edited images). NEVER for user-attached files or files on the user's device - those go through attach_media (the in-chat upload widget, full quality). Never send more than 8000 base64 characters in one call - larger payloads are silently truncated by the chat channel.

altText.description: Alt text stored with the image (recommended).

fileName.description: File name to store under (e.g. chart.png).

mimeType.description: Image MIME type of the file you generated (e.g. image/png). Images only.

name: begin_generated_media_upload
title: Begin Generated Media Upload
